result:
task: DAEO-b6hm (W2-77): make the nightly's clean-up remove only its own clone, by its exact path, with no repo-wide prune
status: DONE. All 24 acceptance tests pass, the change is committed as e9b233772142, and the follow-on suite passes 482 of 482.
work_completed: `night` now reads the clone's administrative entry from the clone's own `.git` file right after `git worktree add`. It removes the clone with `git worktree remove --force <exact path>` only, and the repo-wide `git worktree prune` is gone. If git exits non-zero or the entry is still there afterwards, the nightly deletes that one entry, and only after checking two things: the entry sits directly under `<common dir>/worktrees/`, and its `gitdir` file names the clone's `.git`. A failed removal adds `cleanup: {ok:false, clone, entry, entry_removed, error}` to the record and writes one line naming the clone to standard error. That line is written from the `finally:` block, so it also appears when the night ends in an exception, and the exception passes through unchanged. A successful removal adds no `cleanup` key, and nothing else in the nightly changed. The batch's record copies the night's keys, so it carries `cleanup` without any change to `batch.py`.

discoveries: The acceptance tests make the removal fail by locking the clone. A single `--force` refuses to remove a locked worktree, so this exercises the confirmed-entry path. They also check that git gives the clone a different entry name (`tree1`) when another worktree already holds `tree`. The builder tests cover the same case.
risks: The change is 46 lines added against an estimate of about 20, because of three small helpers with docstrings; there is no logic for cases beyond the KPI lines. `_own_entry` makes one extra `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` call through the existing `_git` helper, and only on the failure path; how git calls build their environment is unchanged. If the entry is not confirmed, the clone's folder is still deleted with its temporary folder, as before, which can leave a stale registration behind. That case is reported in `cleanup`, never pruned.
lessons: Run the W2-77 acceptance tests one file at a time with `--tb=line`; it is much faster than the whole folder (about 9 s for one file against about 4 minutes).
